This
procedure details the inspection steps
I1 for the disconnect switch, which
should be carried out on an annual basis as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

Note: The first draft document initiated by Cairo North 220kv,
and Tebbin 500 substation, Cairo zone

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

The circuit breaker must be isolated completely and
grounded on both sides,

Ensure that the earthing switch must be connected on both
sides of the DS.

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the
work area.
Isolate the DC voltage.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety
glasses.

Multi meter,
 tool set,
Air blower.
220 Vac supply.
SF6 gas leak detector.

End
 scope equipment, moisture tester.

Complete a visual inspection of all components of the
 disconnect switch.

Using the multi meter, check for correct control voltage
 220Vac and
operating voltage 220 Vdc.

Using the air
 blower, clean the mechanism cabinet and check the auxiliary contacts look for signs of overheating.

Checking of control circuits (thorough examination of all
circuit wiring and terminals).

Check the enclosure earth cable to ensure it is properly
fastened and making good connection.

Check the
 condition of the operation mechanism ( auxiliary switches,
interlocks, etc ) and the operating rod ( motion 
 transmission shaft ) look for signs of distortion.

Retighten
 all coupling bolts and joints on the operating rods.

Complete
 a second function operation of the switch via LOCAL and REMOTE control, and
 check the indicator position is operating correctly, also observe any
 unusual noises.
Check the Sf6 pressure this value should be 4 bar.

Using
the leak detector check the entire disconnect switch for Sf6 gas leak.

Using
 moisture tester measure the dew point of the insulating gas it should be not
 greater than 15ppm as indicated in MPIS doc no. TD-SS-004-r0

Measure 
 and record the operating pressure of the SF6 pressure switch. the 2 setting,
 P1 operate at 3.2bar and P2 at 3bar.

Using
 endscope equipment, check the position of the main contacts both open and
 close operations.
